expected_behavior: Project-manifest traceability analysis must pass every layer TSG through the same source enrichment used by single-file analysis, preserving source-only acceptance, forbidden, control, and scenario-only requirement nodes and edges across files.
spec_queries: project traceability source-only acceptance forbidden controls
test_patch:
diff --git a/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_14.rs b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_14.rs
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/rust/fslc/tests/reviewgraphen_generated_calibration_14.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+
+#[test]
+fn reviewgraphen_generated_regression() {
+    let source = include_str!("../src/main.rs");
+    let start = source
+        .find("fn project_traceability_output(")
+        .expect("project traceability implementation");
+    let end = source[start..]
+        .find("\nfn analysis_acceptance_predicates(")
+        .map(|offset| start + offset)
+        .expect("end of project traceability implementation");
+    let implementation = &source[start..end];
+
+    assert!(
+        implementation.contains("enrich_tsg_from_source("),
+        "project layers must retain source-only traceability contracts"
+    );
+}
